paper_identity.title: Evidence of a doublet wobbling excitation mode in 105Pd

cross_mass_significance: Establishes doublet wobbling mode in A~100 (105Pd) with two distinct n_w=1 phonon bands based on js=11/2 and js=7/2 quasineutron alignment orientations, refuting the two-phonon hypothesis (Timar 2019) and clarifying IBFM / TiP controversies (Nomura 2022, Lawrie 2020).
